profile.name: Typhos报警汇总指示组件
profile.description: 一个非物理的软件界面组件，用于汇总 Ophyd 设备多个信号的报警与连接状态，并在 Typhos/PyDM 图形控件上用颜色和工具提示显示最严重的报警情况。它适合用于实验控制界面的状态总览和告警提示。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software UI component that summarizes alarm and connection states from multiple Ophyd device signals, then shows the worst alarm state on Typhos/PyDM graphical widgets using colors and tooltips. It is used for status overview and alarm indication in laboratory control interfaces.

registry.name: SLAC National Accelerator Lab Typhos Alarm
registry.description: Typhos Alarm是由SLAC National Accelerator Lab生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括复位、设备连接、设置、过滤。支持Signal, Slot, add device等操作。
